title: My familiar, after me, calling, Steeeeeeeeeeeephen!
html_source:
As a noun, a familiar is a spirit, or ghost, typically seen as a sort of demon—hence the lengthened “Steeeeeeeeeephen!” (The amount of e’s may not match the text, please forgive, fearful commentator!)

(this is apparently a witch with her “familiars,” which resemble rabbits, or something near in this instance)
